description: This file defines the Filter class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functionality to filter lookup arrays based on match criteria for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to filter lookup arrays based on match arrays, supporting column and row vector operations.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters an array based on match criteria, returning matching items or an error if match array is invalid.

methods.name: enumerateArrayKeys
methods.description: Ensures array keys are sequential and accessible for filtering operations.

methods.name: filterByRow
methods.description: Filters lookup array entries based on row vector match array criteria.

methods.name: filterByColumn
methods.description: Transforms lookup array, applies row filtering, and transposes results to filter by column vector match array.
